Title: Option
Description: One button. Its Body runs when chosen; if the body does not Jump or End, the options are shown again.

Inputs.Description: Connect to a Choice's Options pin.

Options.Label: Text
Options.Description: Button text. Text may use {player}, {npc}, {$var}, {expr ? a : b} and [one|of|these].

Options.Label: If
Options.Description: Hide unless true. A LowTalk expression, e.g. $met, not $player.done, has("Food_Bread", 2), chance(0.5).

Options.Label: Show if
Options.Description: Show greyed out unless true. A LowTalk expression, e.g. $met, not $player.done, has("Food_Bread", 2), chance(0.5).

Options.Label: Once
Options.Description: Hide for good once the player has picked it.

Outputs.Label: Body
Outputs.Description: The statements that run here, in link order: Say, Choice, Set, Jump and so on.
